subject.title: iPhone Continuity Camera `--facing front` always uses rear camera

question: Should macOS camera capture keep `deviceId` as the exact selector when `facing` is also provided for an iPhone Continuity Camera device that reports `position: unspecified`?
rationale: The current code preserves exact device targeting, while the report expects `facing` to choose a lens behind the same external device; that compatibility contract needs maintainer intent and live AVFoundation proof.

options.title: Keep device id exact
options.body: Preserve exact `deviceId` targeting and add a clear limitation or diagnostic if live proof shows Continuity Camera exposes only one selectable camera.

options.title: Add supported lens selection
options.body: If live proof shows a distinct supported front/back selector for the same iPhone device, implement that narrow macOS path with tests and docs.

options.title: Let facing override device id
options.body: Change selector precedence so `facing` can replace an explicit device id, accepting compatibility risk for existing multi-camera users.

recommendation.title: Keep device id exact
recommendation.body: Preserve exact `deviceId` targeting and add a clear limitation or diagnostic if live proof shows Continuity Camera exposes only one selectable camera.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest history across the macOS camera service and original device-selection behavior.
